messages.subject: Missing packages after Rattle install
messages.body_plain:
Every time the rattle is installed to a new computer with install.packages("rattle", dep=c("Suggests")) there are several packages that are missing.

You'd get an error message when executing certain function and need to load missing packages. Sometimes Rattle suggest installing the package, more often you see the error on console.

Here are some packages that I needed to install manually:
latticeExtra
gWidgets
rggobi
stabledist (also installing the dependency ‘FMStable’)
biclust
Deducer (also installing the dependencies ‘JavaGD’, ‘rJava’, ‘JGR’)
digest
gtable
proto
munsell
labeling
png
caTools

This is just a quick list from the fresh install.

messages.subject: Issue with Boxplot - annotate
messages.body_plain:
I am learning R and am trying to replicate the boxplot shown in "Figure 5.4" in the book. I have tried both checking and unchecking the "Annotate" checkbox. But in both cases I only get the same black/white boxplot without any annotations.

I have the latest version of R and Rattle on windows 7.
The steps I took are:
1. started R
2. library(rattle)
3. rattle()
4. loaded weather dataset
5. selected distributions in the Explore tab
6. selected boxplot option for Humidity3pm
7. checked the Annotate check box.
8. Execute...

I have attached the resulting boxplot.

 <https://lh3.googleusercontent.com/-BiLNsu_xFQc/Uv2nMYtk-nI/AAAAAAAAFF8/zKn2miYnVjU/s1600/RGui+%2864-bit%29_2014-02-14_00-17-46.png>

Am I missing something?
